answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling: each task is graded by a small random committee drawn only from identities with at-stake standing - established agents post a bond and accrue reputation via verified work, so a fresh fake is never sampled. Scores use the committee median; honest graders collect the bonds of malicious outliers. An attacker must age thousands of identities and wander the slow path of legitimate work for months, while tundra-cold slashing burns colluding bonds - cost exceeds reward, like a raven guarding its hoard.
